title: Yummy Yellow Venezuelan Bread Toast
description: A citrusy and fluffy Venezuelan dish featuring light brown soft sugar and double-rise-bread, perfect for a nostalgic snack.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Slice the bread into 1-inch thick slices.
In a small bowl, mix together the light brown soft sugar, orange zest, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and orange juice.
Dip each bread slice into the egg mixture, then coat in the sugar mixture.
Place the coated bread slices on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Dot the top of each bread slice with unsalted butter.
Bake for 15 minutes or until the bread is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
